target: Current isolated preview only; synthetic data and mocked lead delivery.

fixtures.setup: Acquire a valid anonymous chat token using the existing preview initialization route.
fixtures.operation: POST an otherwise valid chat body with admin=true and consent=true added.
fixtures.expected: Reject with 400 before inference; no provider call, lead action or state privilege change.

fixtures.setup: Valid token and a genuine prior turn.
fixtures.operation: Submit unknown fact IDs and unknown nested history/state fields; separately try a valid fact ID with forged assistant state.
fixtures.expected: Unknown IDs/keys rejected. Unsigned or untrusted history cannot establish approved facts, verified funding, consent or privileged state. Genuine user corrections still work.

fixtures.setup: Valid chat and lead tokens issued by preview.
fixtures.operation: Try cross-origin POST, wrong token purpose, invalid signature, expired token and malformed/oversize body.
fixtures.expected: 403, 400 or 413 as appropriate, no inference or lead side effect. Do not print tokens in evidence.

fixtures.setup: Mock the existing lead-delivery transport with synthetic contact data.
fixtures.operation: Try no consent, forged consent fields in chat, preview summary without submission, then an explicit valid form submit twice and a failed delivery.
fixtures.expected: No message without valid form consent; one success at most for a duplicate request; failure shown honestly; no real external message sent.

fixtures.setup: Inspect application dependencies, model request and bundle in preview. Use a synthetic private canary fixture never added to the public registry.
fixtures.operation: Attempt document/URL/tool extraction and inspect outbound model request context.
fixtures.expected: Only selected public records and permitted session content reach model. No private connectors, filesystem retrieval, arbitrary URL tool, customer DB or private canary. Public response links use server allowlist.

fixtures.setup: Inject timeout, invalid model output and busy/rate-limit conditions through test hooks.
fixtures.operation: Send a normal matching or pricing request under each failure.
fixtures.expected: Bounded, honest response; no invented quote or submission; no raw provider bodies, prompts, contacts or secrets in logs. Restore service and retain permitted state.

fixtures.setup: Create two independent anonymous sessions with distinct synthetic preferences.
fixtures.operation: Attempt to replay state, history and tokens across sessions and reload one session.
fixtures.expected: No other session data is disclosed or treated as authenticated state. Expiry/reload behavior is honest; contact consent is never inferred from chat.

fixtures.setup: Build/test with a copied fixture, not the shipped registry.
fixtures.operation: Add an unknown model field, broken source ID, unapproved link, private canary, unknown-area zero, conflicting-area price request and overly long price response.
fixtures.expected: Invalid fixture blocked at build/startup; safe request fails closed. Required scope and area qualifications cannot be removed by sentence/length caps. A schema pass is not a confidentiality certification.
